verdict.rationale: Langfuse explicitly documents a dedicated CI/CD experiments feature described as 'Block deploys on regressions' with a linked doc page (evaluation/experiments/experiments-ci-cd), directly matching the story of gating deployments on eval results, and this is paired with dataset-based experiments and code/LLM-as-judge evaluators for scoring runs.
